SAMPLE SIZE.evidence_source: Study 1 established test–retest reliability (r = .81, p < .0001) and internal consistency reliability (α = .96) in a sample of 117 undergraduate students. Study 2 established predictive validity of the CAQ against artist ratings of a creative product, a collage (r = .59, p < .0001, n = 39). Study 3 (n = 86) established convergent validity with other measures of creative potential.

ES.evidence_source: Study 3 (n = 86) established convergent validity with other measures of creative potential, including divergent thinking tests (r = .47, p < .0001), the Creative Personality Scale (Gough, 1979; r = .33, p = .004), Intellect (Goldberg, 1992; r = .51, p < .0001), and Openness to Experience (Costa & McCrae, 1992; r = .33, p = .002). The correlation between Intellect and CAQ is 0.51.

Effects.evidence_source: For Study 3, the correlation between Intellect and CAQ is 0.51, which is one effect size. No other studies reported correlations between intelligence and creative achievement.

Measure IQ.evidence_source: Study 3 established convergent validity with other measures of creative potential, including divergent thinking tests (r = .47, p < .0001), the Creative Personality Scale (Gough, 1979; r = .33, p = .004), Intellect (Goldberg, 1992; r = .51, p < .0001), and Openness to Experience (Costa & McCrae, 1992; r = .33, p = .002). Study 4 established discriminant validity between the CAQ and both IQ and self-serving bias.

Creativity Measures.evidence_source: The Creative Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ) is a new self-report measure of creative achievement that assesses achievement across 10 domains of creativity. Study 1 established test–retest reliability... Study 2 established predictive validity of the CAQ... Study 3 (n = 86) established convergent validity... Study 4 established discriminant validity between the CAQ... Study 5 examined the factor structure of the CAQ.

Domain classified.evidence_source: The Creative Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ) is a new self-report measure of creative achievement that assesses achievement across 10 domains of creativity. Study 5 examined the factor structure of the CAQ. A three-factor solution identified Expressive, Scientific, and Performance factors of creative achievement. A two-factor solution identified an Arts factor and a Science factor.

section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces the Creative Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ), a self-report measure of creative achievement across 10 domains. Five studies are described: Study 1 (n=117) established reliability, Study 2 (n=39) established predictive validity, and Study 3 (n=86) established convergent validity, including a correlation between Intellect and CAQ. Study 4 investigated discriminant validity with IQ, and Study 5 examined the CAQ's factor structure, identifying Arts and Science factors.
